description: This Java class defines a custom runtime exception used within the document management module of the Fineract project, specifically thrown when an invalid entity type is encountered for document management operations.

classes.name: InvalidEntityTypeForDocumentManagementException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception indicating an invalid entity type for document management operations, extending a platform-specific resource not found exception.

methods.name: InvalidEntityTypeForDocumentManagementException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific error code, message, and entity type parameter.
